name: Cooperative dinks at the kitchen line
summary: Two players at the non-volley-zone line dink softly to each other, straight then cross-court, keeping the ball alive.
setup: Both players at the non-volley-zone line, facing each other across the net
First half: straight dinks; second half: cross-court dinks
Cooperative: aim for the partner's paddle, no attacking shots
success_criterion: One rally of 20 consecutive dinks that land in the non-volley zone
safety_notes: Cooperative pace, no speed-ups. Stop if in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) The common on-court warm-up; soft, cooperative contact sets touch and the ready position before live balls. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
